notes.title: Nobody Nowhere is Now Available! (Cloud Save Temporarily Disabled)
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience! Nobody Nowhere is now live and ready to play—welcome!


 With a linear plot and a single ending, it takes about 3 hours to complete. 


 There are no restrictions on live streaming or recording, so feel free to share and discuss your experience with others!


Important Notes:
Cloud Save: Since the game is relatively short, Steam Cloud saves are temporarily disabled, so your progress won't carry over if you switch devices.

Steam Deck Compatibility:The game has been tested on Steam Deck, but due to issues like lagging and audio-video sync problems during the ending song, we do not recommend playing on Steam Deck.

Bug Report:
If you encounter any bugs while playing, please reach out to us!

Bug report via QQ group: ：809436637
Discord:Nobody Nowhere

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Nobody Nowhere Launching Tomorrow—Feb 17, 2025!
notes.content:
Nobody Nowhere will be launched tomorrow, which is Feb 17, 2025!
Thank you for your patience! The official version is finally here and ready to meet you.

About the Game:

 With about 3 hours of gameplay,Nobody Nowhere features 50+ maps, 130+ character illustrations, and 260+ pixel animations, all designed to immerse you in the story.


 Please note that Steam Cloud and Steam Deck support are temporarily disabled.


Join the discussion in our official channel:
QQ Group: 923500627
Discord：Nobody Nowhere

Lastly, enjoy the countdown to Nobody Nowhere's release with our special celebratory images!
